notes:
T356 — give every claimlint check a canonical name alongside its ID. This file records the labelling change; it proposes no register claim status change and no new register row.

=== THE MAPPING (single source of truth) ===

The name<->number mapping lives in exactly one place: `const CHECKS` in src/claimlint.zig, surfaced through `checkName(id)`. Every output line pulls the name from there; no name string is duplicated in a literal. To rename a check, edit CHECKS and every section header, failure line, summary row and calibration line follows.

  C1a  ORPHANED         claim resting on a retracted ancestor
  C1b  STALE-NEGATION   `n:` edge whose parent is no longer FALSE
  C2   DEAD-LINKS       cited evidence paths that do not resolve in-repo
  C3   UNBACKED         PROVEN rows with no committed evidence
  C4   GHOST-IDS        references to claim IDs that do not exist
  C5   SHADOWED         dependency shadowed by a nearer one
  C6   MISCITED         cite tag disagrees with the row it cites
  C7   UNABSORBED       findings not reconciled into the register
  C8   UNKILLED         mutants alive under a PROVEN claim
  C9   UNMAPPED         register row absent from the requirement tree

C0 (PARSE), A (repeated-narrowing smell) and B (weak evidence) are not in the table and carry no name — they are not checks in the same sense.

=== WHAT CHANGED IN src/claimlint.zig ===

1. Added `Check`, `CHECKS` and `checkName` after `SCOPES` — the one source of truth.
2. The top descriptive comment block now leads each check with `ID NAME (descriptive)`.
3. Every section header carries both: e.g. `== C3 UNBACKED  PROVEN WITHOUT COMMITTED EVIDENCE ... ==`. The C1 section (parent of C1a/C1b) reads `== C1  ORPHAN DETECTION — C1a ORPHANED · C1b STALE-NEGATION ... ==`.
4. Every sub-header and per-check total line carries both: `C1a ORPHANED orphans: 10`, `C2 DEAD-LINKS total: 14`, etc. ONE exception: the C8 per-section total (`  C8 mutation-adequacy violations: N`) is left in its exact grep-able form because tools/regression-claimlint-promotion.sh extracts its count with `grep '^  C8 mutation-adequacy violations: ' | sed 's/.*: //'`; inserting or appending the name there breaks the parse. The name UNKILLED is carried by the C8 section header and the SUMMARY row, so the brief's three required surfaces (summary, section header, failure line) all still carry both.
5. Every failure line carries both: `C1a ORPHANED  \`<id>\``, `C2 DEAD-LINKS  <path>`, `C6 MISCITED  MISMATCH ...`, `C9 UNMAPPED  BAD CELL ...`, etc.
6. The summary table appends `[NAME]` (or `[C1a ORPHANED / C1b STALE-NEGATION]`) after the status tag on every C1a-C9 row.
7. The calibration lines carry both, e.g. `known-bad 2 (C2 DEAD-LINKS):`.

=== PRE-COMMIT HOOK COMPATIBILITY ===

The hook (tools/hooks/pre-commit, NOT a T356 deliverable and NOT modified) greps four summary lines and reads their numbers by awk field position:
  ^  C1a orphans / C1b alarms   -> $6, $8
  ^  C2 dangling evidence paths -> $5
  ^  C6 cite-tag mismatches     -> $4
  ^  C9 tree-mapping violations -> $4
Appending `[NAME]` AFTER the `(FAILS)` tag leaves every numbered field in its original position, so the grep prefixes and awk indices are unchanged. The floor file reader (`d['floor']['C1a']`) is unchanged: the numeric keys and values are untouched; a `names` map was added alongside.
